ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.15:0.85 (High-intensity white to Low-intensity black); high-intensity pixels are restricted to the distal tips of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white block covering approximately 20% of the left distal lobe; fragmented high-intensity white patch on the right distal lobe containing dense low-intensity (black) mottling and focal spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central depression with an approximate internal angle of 40 degrees; symmetric placement at the fluke midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme irregularity on the left lobe due to a major semi-circular tissue void (negative space); right lobe exhibits a continuous linear boundary with low-amplitude, high-frequency micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical; right lobe follows a continuous concave-to-convex arc terminating in an acute distal point; left lobe trajectory is truncated and jagged due to structural tissue loss.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters visible within the dark pigment of the mid-right lobe and inside the white patch of the distal right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major structural amputation/tissue loss forming a large notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe; secondary jagged irregular protrusion proximal to the median notch on the left side.
other_distinctive_markers: The left lobe distal tip exhibits a squared-off, truncated morphology compared to the tapered tip of the right lobe.
